sources.title: Верификация KYC для физических лиц — часто задаваемые вопросы
observations: Identity Verification of at least Standard level is mandatory for all Bybit Kazakhstan products and services.
Higher verification levels may be required depending on region, product, or service.
The page describes accepted identity and proof-of-address documents, but no account-level verification was performed.
limitations: Public help-center documentation does not prove approval for a specific user.
KYC requirements and accepted documents may change and require freshness checks before publication.

sources.title: FAQ — P2P Advertisers
observations: Bybit Kazakhstan states zero platform transaction fees for P2P buyers and sellers; payment-provider fees may still apply.
The published KZT/USDT per-ad order range is 900 KZT minimum and 22,000,000 KZT maximum.
The actual tradable amount depends on the range set by the advertiser.
limitations: Published per-ad limits do not prove that an active advertisement exists at the current moment.
The values are date-bound and must be rechecked before public publication.

sources.title: Анонсы
observations: The official announcements index lists the launch of Bybit Kazakhstan's regulated P2P platform in November 2025.
The index shows a P2P launch entry dated 2025-11-10.
limitations: The announcements index confirms a dated launch signal but does not prove current active advertisements or universal user eligibility.
The direct article URL was not independently captured in this mapping.

sources.title: Buy and Sell Tether (USDT) with Freedom Bank | Binance P2P
observations: A Kazakhstan-localized Binance P2P route exists for a Freedom Bank payment-method surface.
The public result exposes Buy and Sell controls and an advertiser-table structure.
limitations: The public result did not provide evidence of a currently active advertiser or executable order.
Route existence and table structure do not prove active offers, both directions, resident eligibility, or current payment availability.

sources.title: Binance P2P sell surface
observations: A Kazakhstan-localized public Binance P2P sell-route surface is discoverable.
The page exposes Buy and Sell controls and a payment-method filter.
limitations: The route does not establish a currently active KZT order or a specific supported payment method.
No login, account, order, transaction, proxy, or KYC test was performed.
